definition: underwear that supports a woman's breasts
description: In a sunny narrow courtyard between old ochre houses with peeling plaster and wooden shutters, washing hangs on lines strung across: striped towels, shirts, grey socks, a white sheet and, in the middle, a coral-pink bra hanging from a wooden peg. The wind flips the bra up over the line and it swings back down while the white sheet flutters. A peg falls and lands in a puddle on the wet cobbles below, near a bicycle in a doorway, a broom, a crate of bottles and red geraniums.
